# Evaluation Rubric: Agile Story Splitter

Use this rubric to evaluate the quality of the story split.

| Criteria | 1 - Poor | 3 - Good | 5 - Excellent |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Split Strategy** | Horizontal (FE/BE) | Vertical slices used | Best pattern chosen from P1–P8; justified |
| **Independence** | Highly coupled | Mostly independent | Slices can ship and deliver value alone |
| **Format** | Incomplete stories | Full AGILE STORY box format | 2–5 complete, high-quality sub-stories |
| **Summary Table** | Missing | Present with pattern and points | Detailed summary with rationale for total diff |
| **INVEST** | Not validated | Validated with some flags | Rigorous validation; flags handled correctly |
